finding: Governed `atm git commit` can spend more than two minutes inside pre-commit without progress output, leaving the operator unable to tell whether it is hung or still validating after auto-stage succeeded.
expectedBehavior: Long-running governed commit hooks should emit phase heartbeats or a resumable receipt showing stage succeeded, hook is running, and the active branch-queue lock owner/pid.
evidenceOrRepro: During ATM-GOV-0243 delivery commit, `node atm.mjs git commit --actor codex-git-series-captain --task ATM-GOV-0243 --message ... --auto-stage --json` timed out at 124s in the caller while node pid 92480 continued `atm.mjs git commit` and pid 92620 ran `atm.dev.mjs hook pre-commit --json`; the commit later completed as ecf573c44.
followUp: Add governed-commit progress receipts and a safe resume/status command for staged-but-hook-running commit lanes.
